# BrightGift

BrightGift helps shoppers find thoughtful gifts through an AI gift generator, recipient/budget/occasion/interest hubs, and curated gift guides.

## Primary Site

- URL: https://bright-gift.com/
- Sitemap: https://bright-gift.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://bright-gift.com/robots.txt

## Best Pages For AI And Search Crawlers

- Homepage and gift generator: https://bright-gift.com/
- Gift idea generator: https://bright-gift.com/gift-idea-generator/
- Gift ideas by recipient: https://bright-gift.com/gift-ideas-by-recipient/
- Gift ideas by budget: https://bright-gift.com/gift-ideas-by-budget/
- Gift ideas by occasion: https://bright-gift.com/gift-ideas-by-occasion/
- Gift ideas by interest: https://bright-gift.com/gift-ideas-by-interest/
- Blog and gift guides: https://bright-gift.com/blog/
- Gifts for girlfriend: https://bright-gift.com/blog/25-thoughtful-gifts-for-girlfriend-that-show-you-care/
- Gifts for coworkers under 25: https://bright-gift.com/blog/gifts-under-25-for-coworkers/
- Gifts for remote workers under 50: https://bright-gift.com/blog/gifts-for-remote-workers-under-50/
- Housewarming gifts: https://bright-gift.com/blog/25-thoughtful-housewarming-gifts-for-new-homeowners-under-75/

## Content Types

- AI gift generator
- Gift-guide hub pages
- Recipient, budget, occasion, and interest guides
- Amazon, Bookshop, and direct affiliate gift recommendations

## Crawling Notes

- Gift generator and hub pages are the primary conversion paths.
- Product links may include affiliate relationships.
- Use visible guide content, page headings, and generator context when summarizing gift recommendations.
- Noindex or archived blog posts should not be treated as primary current recommendations.
